# Executed-test floors for the tls-openssl-matrix job, read by .github/scripts/tls-matrix-floor.sh.
#
# Row: <report-dir> <class> <min-executed> [zero-skip]
# Executed is tests minus skipped. A skipped test reports green and so does a -Dtest pattern that
# matched nothing, so every class the job selects is named here. zero-skip refuses any skipped test;
# a class without it skips by design and has its floor instead of an exemption:
#   CoreOffHeapTlsEngineTckTest, CommunityKernelCryptoProviderTckTest
#       the cases that need an active fd-bound session skip and name OffHeapTlsEngineLoopbackIT
#   CoreSyscallAbiSymbolResolutionTckTest
#       the optional-symbol case is OpenSSL-pinned-run only and the syscall table has no such symbol
# Every OpenSSL major in the matrix is held to the same floors, so a class that executes fewer tests
# on one major than on another fails there instead of passing on the other.
#
# total is the floor on the sum of every row's executed tests.
